title: Sections and stalks of the structure sheaf of Proj on standard opens
statement: Let $S=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}S_n$ be an $\mathbf N$-graded commutative ring and $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. For a point $x\in X$ with homogeneous prime $\mathfrak p$ let $S_{(\mathfrak p)}$ be the ring of fractions $y/h$ with $y,h\in S$ homogeneous, $\deg y=\deg h$, $h\notin\mathfrak p$ (a subring of the localization of $S$ at the homogeneous elements outside $\mathfrak p$). Then: (i) there is a ring isomorphism $\varphi_x:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to S_{(\mathfrak p)}$; (ii) for $f\in S$ homogeneous of positive degree there is a ring isomorphism $\theta_f:S_{(f)}\to\Gamma(D_+(f),\mathcal O_X)$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero] such that for every $x\in D_+(f)$ with prime $\mathfrak p$ and every $y/f^m\in S_{(f)}$, $\varphi_x$ maps the germ of $\theta_f(y/f^m)$ at $x$ to the fraction $y/f^m\in S_{(\mathfrak p)}$.
